# Attribution

*Generated by `python3 tools/attribution_stats.py --markdown` on 2026-11-20. Don't edit by hand.*

Who made the decisions behind this translation, as far as the records show. Claude drafts the English; Avi Craimer makes the terminology rulings, sets the conventions and revises the text. The rules for recording attribution are in `LEXICON.md` ("Attribution") and `CLAUDE.md`. A decision credited to Avi means he examined the term in context, asked about its linguistic range and made a considered ruling. It does not mean he glanced at a proposal and approved it. Where he confirmed a proposal rather than proposing it, the confirmation came after that examination.
